messages.author: 34d1b12964c01466
messages.subject: Pass a list to filter
parts:
I would like to filer on a list, eg:

x <- c(6,8)

mtcars %>% filter(cyl == x)

I'm thinking there may be an dplyr SE fix with filter_, but I can't figure it out or find a similar issue on SO.

FYI, this is motivated by a desire to pass an uncertain user-defined list to a df within a reactive context in Shiny.

Thank you in advance.

messages.author: f200486bc1a6d9ad
messages.subject: Re: Pass a list to filter
parts:
You might try:

mtcars %>% filter(cyl %in% x)

I'm assuming that you don't mean an object of class 'list' but rather a vector like you have defined above.

parts:
thank you very much, and it works with a list:

mtcars %<>% mutate(model = rownames(mtcars)) #tidy

some_models <- list('Datsun 710', 'AMC Javelin')

mtcars %>% filter(model %in% some_models)
